example {kbar : Type u} [Field kbar] [IsAlgClosed kbar]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of kbar))) [IsProper C.hom]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    [IsIntegral C.left] [IsNoetherian C.left]
    [Scheme.IsRegularInCodimensionOne C.left]
    (D : C.left.WeilDivisor) :
    degK kbar D = Scheme.WeilDivisor.degree D := by
  have hfin : ∀ P : C.left.PrimeDivisor, Module.Finite kbar (localStepTgt kbar P 1) := by
    intro P
    have happrox := hasRationalResidues_of_isAlgClosed_curve C P
    have hone : (1 : C.left.functionField) ∈ orderGeSub kbar P (1 - 1) := by
      rw [mem_orderGeSub]
      exact Or.inr (by rw [Scheme.RationalMap.order_one]; norm_num)
    refine Module.Finite.of_surjective
      (Finsupp.linearCombination kbar (fun _ : Unit => Submodule.Quotient.mk
        (p := Submodule.comap (orderGeSub kbar P (1 - 1)).subtype (orderGeSub kbar P 1))
        ⟨1, hone⟩)) ?_
    intro z
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ z
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := happrox (g : C.left.functionField) (by
      have hg2 := g.2
      rw [mem_orderGeSub] at hg2
      exact orderGe_antitone (by norm_num) hg2)
    refine ⟨Finsupp.single () c, ?_⟩
    simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
    rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, Submodule.Quotient.eq, Submodule.mem_comap,
      Submodule.subtype_apply]
    have hval : ((c • ⟨1, hone⟩ - g : orderGeSub kbar P (1 - 1)) :

      change c • (1 : C.left.functionField) - (g : C.left.functionField) = _
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]; ring
    rw [mem_orderGeSub, hval]
    exact (orderGe P 1).neg_mem hc
  haveI := hfin
  exact degK_eq_degree_of_isAlgClosed_curve C D

end Adelic
